description: Sells a position in a pump.fun coin: with a wallet, an unsigned Solana transaction (base64) to sign and send yourself or with send_tx (pumpdata never holds a key); without one, the coin's sell page already open on the right amount (tokens: "all", a share such as "50%", or an exact raw amount), where a person signs with their own wallet. pumpdata's 0.4% fee (the answer's `fee_compare` sets it beside fomo, Axiom, Photon, GMGN and Trojan: tell the person). For: sell all, sell this coin, take my bag off.

tokens.description: the raw whole units to sell (pump.fun tokens have 6 decimals, so 1,500.5 tokens is 1500500000), a share such as "50%", or "all" (default)

wallet.description: the address that signs and pays; leave it out to get the signing page instead of a transaction

name: sell_coin
